notes: In Spanish, you can use double negatives: 'No veo nada' (literally 'I don't see nothing'). This is standard and grammatically required in Spanish, unlike in English where it is considered incorrect.
Use 'no' before a verb to make it negative. If you need to make a negative sentence even stronger, you add words like 'nadie' (nobody) or 'nunca' (never) after the verb.
